providers.reason: Eli Lilly recently broke out to fresh all-time highs above $1,300, resolving a two-month consolidation phase. Momentum is accelerating ahead of the October 29 earnings report, fueled by positive Phase 3 pediatric data for Omvoh and a new $1.1 billion AI-driven drug delivery partnership. Recent analyst target raises to $1,440+ support further near-term upside.
providers.risk: High valuation premiums increase sensitivity to any perceived growth slowdown in GLP-1 drug sales.

providers.reason: Shares hit an all-time high near $1,311 on Oct 20, extending a 21% YTD advance, as Foundayo obesity-pill sales accelerate in the US and abroad. Q3 results land Oct 29, just outside the 2–5 day window, leaving momentum and pre-earnings positioning as the near-term drivers.
providers.risk: The 5% Oct 20 jump lacked a clear catalyst, raising chase/profit-taking risk; overbought conditions into the print could produce sharp reversals.

providers.reason: Record high $1,311 on massive weight-loss drug demand (Mounjaro/Zepbound $27.7B H1 revenue). Strong momentum with analysts raising targets ahead of Q3 earnings Oct 29. Technical breakout above prior highs.
providers.risk: Q3 earnings Oct 29 approaching creates binary event risk; stock at all-time highs vulnerable to pullback if results disappoint or guidance lacks upside.

providers.reason: Goldman lifted to $1413 Buy on expected Q3 beat/raise on Mounjaro ex-US and Zepbound volumes; record high above Berkshire, 26/31 Buys.
providers.risk: Overbought ATH vulnerable to profit-taking and pre-market weakness; high expectations into Oct 29.
